verdict.rationale: Kick's Activity tab is documented as a full audit trail logging every transaction change, categorization update, and sync event with timestamp and the identity (human or AI agent) that made the change (kick-docs-10, kick-supp-audit-trail), directly matching the 'who changed what and when' requirement. Multi-entity support (kick-docs-5, kick-docs-19) confirms entities each have their own books, but there is no explicit documentation of a consolidated cross-entity audit view or export capability for accountants. Missing for 10: explicit cross-entity/consolidated audit trail view, filtering/export features for audits, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the audit log's completeness.
